blackmagic.title: Black Magic
blackmagic.rule1: Pick some items from the room (use real objects nearby)
blackmagic.rule2: Performer steps out — everyone picks a secret target item
blackmagic.rule3: Assistant holds the phone and points to each item asking 'Is it this one?'
blackmagic.rule4: Performer gets it right every single time!
blackmagic.setupDesc: Enter items from the room (3–8 items)
blackmagic.performerOutDesc: Wait for them to move away and not see the screen
blackmagic.pickTargetDesc: Everyone agree on one item — don't let the performer see!
blackmagic.performerBackDesc: Ready? Assistant holds the phone and points to each item asking 'Is it this one?'
blackmagic.signalHint: Point to any nearby dark/black item and ask 'Is it this one?'
blackmagic.itemHint: Point to '{{item}}' and ask 'Is it this one?'
blackmagic.signalNext: 👆 The next one is the target!
blackmagic.targetNote: ✅ This is it! Point to it naturally
blackmagic.confirmReveal: Sure you want to see the secret? Once you know, the magic is gone!
blackmagic.secretDesc: Before pointing to the target, the assistant first points to a dark/black item. When the performer sees 'dark item', they know: the next one is the answer!
blackmagic.secretTip: Tip: next time try a different color as the signal to make it harder to crack!

celebrity.title: Celebrity Guess
celebrity.tagline: Male or female? Singer or athlete? Guess in 20 questions!
celebrity.rule1: One host secretly thinks of a celebrity
celebrity.rule2: Others take turns asking yes/no questions
celebrity.rule3: Host can only answer: Yes, No, or Kind of
celebrity.rule4: Guess correctly within 20 questions to win!
celebrity.secretHint: Type a celebrity name — keep it hidden from others!
celebrity.secretLabel: Pass the phone to the other players after confirming
celebrity.guessPrompt: Who do you think it is?
